notes: Three «ح» branches meet at «عبيد الله»: the names written once after the last «ح» (عبيد الله، نافع، ابن عمر) are the shared tail (rule 3).
«وهو القطان» after يحيى is an editor's gloss identifying him: left out. «- واللفظ له -» is a gloss: left out.
The surface of group 2 keeps the stray comma of the text (أبي، شيبة).
